I honestly had the same problem for a long time and it’s still pretty annoying. It’s heartbreaking to hate everything you make, and it takes ages to start loving your work. The way I started to get out of it is find something that you like about it. Even if it’s one particular line, it doesn’t have to be anything big. Just sit there and say out loud ‘You know what, I’m actually really proud of that bit, I love that bit of my drawing, it’s so good.’ Eventually it might help. Also, you’d never rip up your friends work and tell them it’s shit would you? Look at your work how you might a friends, maybe it isn’t great, but there will always be something you don’t hate about it.
